verdict.rationale: The only bulk operations in the evidence are all-or-nothing, in-app features: exporting all of your data and deleting all of your data. The Developer API offers paginated listing and time-range audio download, but delete operations work on one lifelog or chat at a time by ID, so no programmatic bulk operations are documented. Missing for 10: bulk API endpoints (multi-ID delete/update/star), selective bulk actions on filtered sets, bulk operations exposed via MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
